known_exceptions.note: The one truly irregular i-adjective. いい is only used in the dictionary form and the polite present (いいです). Every other form is built on the stem よ- instead of い-: 良くない (not いくない), 良かった (not いかった), 良ければ, etc. This is a very well known exception and any general 'remove い and add X' rule needs a special case for this one word.

forms.usage_en: The basic plain form used to end a sentence informally or as a base for other forms.

na-adjective.rule: the citation/dictionary form is the bare stem (e.g. 静か); だ is the plain copula added to end a sentence, not part of the word itself
na-adjective.note: Dictionaries list na-adjectives as the bare stem alone. We include だ here because this row represents 'plain form used to end a sentence' to stay parallel with the i-adjective row above.

forms.usage_en: The standard polite present form used in formal conversation.

i-adjective.rule: add です to dictionary form

na-adjective.rule: add です to the stem

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add くない

na-adjective.rule: add ではない (colloquially じゃない) to the stem

forms.name_jp: ひていのていねいけい
forms.usage_en: Formal negative form for polite communication.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add くありません or くないです

na-adjective.rule: add ではありません to the stem

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add かった

na-adjective.rule: add だった to the stem

forms.usage_en: Formal past tense for polite communication.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add かったです

na-adjective.rule: add でした to the stem

forms.usage_en: Casual past negative form for 'was not'.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add くなかった

na-adjective.rule: add ではなかった to the stem

forms.name_jp: かこのひていのていねいけい

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add くなかったです or くありませんでした

na-adjective.rule: add ではありませんでした to the stem
na-adjective.result: ではありませんでした

forms.usage_en: Converts the adjective into an adverb to modify verbs.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add く

forms.usage_en: The conjunctive form used to connect adjectives or provide reasons.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add くて
remove い and add ければ

na-adjective.rule: add なら (or ならば) to the stem

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add かったら

na-adjective.rule: add だったら to the stem

forms.name_en: wanting something to be a certain way
forms.usage_en: Corrected from the source file. Adjectives do not take てほしい directly (that pattern attaches to a VERB's te-form, e.g. 行ってほしい 'I want you to go'). To say you want something/someone to BE a certain way, put the adjective in its adverbial form and add なってほしい ('become' + ほしい), e.g. 静かになってほしい 'I want it to be quiet' (lit. 'become quiet').

i-adjective.rule: remove い, add く, then attach なってほしい

na-adjective.rule: add に to the stem, then attach なってほしい

forms.usage_en: Literary or formal way to connect clauses without using 'te'. For i-adjectives this is the same surface form as the adverbial form above, just used to link clauses rather than modify a verb.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add く

na-adjective.rule: add で to the stem (same surface form as te-form)

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add すぎる

na-adjective.rule: add すぎる to the stem

forms.usage_en: The form used to directly modify a noun.

i-adjective.rule: keep い and place before noun

na-adjective.rule: add な to the stem and place before noun

forms.usage_en: Converts an adjective into a noun representing the quality or degree.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add さ

forms.usage_en: Expresses that something appears to be a certain way. Irregular: いい/良い → 良さそう (not 良そう), and ない → なさそう (not なそう) — both insert an extra さ before そう.

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add そう (irregular for いい/良い → 良さそう and ない → なさそう)

na-adjective.rule: add そう to the stem

i-adjective.rule: remove い and add くなくて

na-adjective.rule: add ではなくて to the stem
